scope: Checker memory diagnosis and a value-preserving patch; partial check-only evidence, no compiler qualification.

patch.what: FnRecord::bodyevents becomes a snapshot of immutable 64-event chunks of the store-event log; a chunk whose snapshotted fields (container, root, src, exact, classread, argcopy) did not change since its last copy is shared. Values read are identical.

heap_attribution.method: LD_PRELOAD sampling allocator (build/goose-port/memsample, 1 MiB sampling, live tracking), server root on the 01-17 checker, last dump before the 14G OOM kill at 392s
top: CheckSpecBodyOnce typecheck_calls.h:3493 (FnRecord::bodyevents copy of the whole event range per record)
heap_attribution.cause: Every record copied its whole event range, which contains the ranges of all callees first checked inside it: events x nesting depth copies.

server_root.before: OOM-killed at the 14G cap (392s under the sampler; RSS 14.2G after ~25 min under check_engines)

after.first_error: backend/result_publication.goose:72 storing a reference rooted at units (§9.2)

differential.tests: upstream d5ae5bb test/**/*.goose, goose check --diagnostics json, exit code and output compared
differential.explanation: errors_tc/recovery/imports.goose, imported/helper.goose and lsp/broken_decls.goose list each binary's own built-in stdlib directory in "looked for" paths; no checking difference.
